classification.difficultyReason: Calculate each organic contribution as a percentage of the whole crop, then combine the contributions.

content.prompt: A farm grows both barley and wheat. $30\%$ of the barley is grown organically and $60\%$ of the wheat is grown organically. $70\%$ of the grain produced by the farm is wheat and the remainder is barley. What percentage of the farm’s grain is organically grown?

answer.short:
$51\%$.

Find each crop’s organic contribution to the whole, then add.
answer.worked:
Barley accounts for $100\%-70\%=30\%$ of the grain.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Organic barley as a percentage of all grain}&=\frac{30}{100}\times30\%\\\text{Organic barley as a percentage of all grain}&=9\%\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}\text{Organic wheat as a percentage of all grain}&=\frac{60}{100}\times70\%\\\text{Organic wheat as a percentage of all grain}&=42\%\end{align*}$$

The crops are separate parts of the same whole, so the percentage organically grown is $9\%+42\%=51\%$.
